name: Pinion
author: Erin Carter
description: A Phoenix Julia set whose two-term escape-time recurrence grows ranks of luminous feather-fronds fanning from a dark central body. As a hidden memory coefficient rides a slow circle the plumage preens — barbs curl and release, fronds fork and merge, the fan widens and narrows like a wing.

params.label: Feather
params.effect: Radius of the memory coefficient's circuit — how far the plumage strays from the classic phoenix toward wilder fan shapes.

params.label: Writhe speed
params.effect: How quickly the plumage preens and reforms; 0 freezes a single fully drawn fan.

params.label: Zoom
params.effect: Magnification about the body, from the full open fan to a close stand of feather-fronds.

params.label: Glow reach
params.effect: Depth of the luminous escape margin along each frond before it falls to black.
